actual: On clean main 1182e925, the first authorized P2-4 request preparation for frozen candidate 792d4f6a failed after holdout access but before product acceptance. Durable receipt canonical e4397982 records holdout_accessed=true, product_acceptance_performed=false, zero fit/selection/model/READY/DB/runtime. The underlying StateModelSetError is hmm_risk_stock_fact_provider_absence_unverified for 601969.SH/2026-01-30/market.moneyflow_ts, while the hard-coded provider_absence_v1 audit authority ends 2024-06-30. The P2-4 receipt incorrectly collapses this typed source defect to hmm_risk_p2_4_unknown_execution_failure. Fix must preserve the frozen candidate, D1-D6 thresholds, zero refit/reselection, and fail-closed semantics; it must provide an audited holdout source-authority path and typed failure classification without deleting or overwriting the first failure receipt. Any policy permitting a post-fix holdout rerun is a separate model-contract decision requiring user approval.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
